d: Mandarin Oriental, Doha is looking for a Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our Marketing Communications team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
r: Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Marketing Communications Department in Doha, the Graphic & Multimedia Designer is responsible for creating visually compelling and brand-compliant creative assets across print, digital, social media, photography, videography and multimedia platforms. As a brand guardian, the role ensures all visual communications align with Mandarin Oriental brand standards while supporting marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, guest engagement and commercial performance. The Graphic & Multimedia Designer reports to the Assistant Marketing Communications Manager.
As Graphic & Multimedia Designer, you will be responsible for the following duties
Design and produce creative marketing collateral including brochures, menus, advertisements, banners, invitations and promotional materials.
Create engaging visual content for social media, digital campaigns, website updates and email marketing initiatives.
Support photography, videography and multimedia production, including editing, retouching, motion graphics and short-form video content.
Collaborate with hotel departments, agencies and external vendors to ensure timely delivery of high-quality creative projects while maintaining Mandarin Oriental brand standards.
As Graphic & Multimedia Designer, We Expect From You

Degree in Graphic Design or equivalent, with 2-3 years of experience in graphic design, multimedia design or creative services. Experience within luxury hospitality, luxury retail, lifestyle brands or creative agencies is preferred.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro and After Effects, supported by a strong professional portfolio.
Strong creative, organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining exceptional quality and attention to detail.
Understanding of luxury branding, visual storytelling and social media content best practices. Excellent English communication skills are essential, with Arabic being an advantage.
Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.

Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.
A competitive salary and benefits packages
